company_description: The Clorox Company manufactures and markets consumer and professional products worldwide. The company operates through four segments: Health and Wellness, Household, Lifestyle, and International. The Health and Wellness segment offers home care cleaning and disinfecting products, bleach, clog removers, and laundry additives under the Clorox, Clorox2, Pine-Sol, Scentiva, Tilex, Liquid-Plumr, Poett, and Formula 409 brands; professional cleaning and disinfecting products under the CloroxPro and Clorox Healthcare brands; professional food service products under the Hidden Valley brand in the United States. The Household segment provides cat litter products under the Fresh Step and Scoop Away brands; bags and wraps under the Glad brand; and grilling products under the Kingsford brand in the United States. The Lifestyle segment offers dressings, dips, seasonings, and sauces primarily under the Hidden Valley brand; water-filtration products under the Brita brand; and natural personal care products under the Burt's Bees brand in the United States. risks.title: Cyberattacks and operational disruptions
risks.summary: Clorox suffered a major cyberattack in August 2023 from which it has recovered. The risk of future attacks disrupting operations, sales, and data remains significant for a global company operating in 25 countries.
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed at the beginning of the report (Item 1.C) with strong language ('could materially harm', 'operational disruption'). Although the company has recovered from the August 2023 attack, the risk remains existential for a $7.1 billion company dependent on complex supply chains. Cybersecurity category = maximum weighting.

risks.title: Volatility in raw material costs
risks.summary: Prices of raw materials, energy, and transportation fluctuate significantly. Clorox is highly exposed, particularly due to new tariffs, which directly impact its margins and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named in the Risk Factors section with impact language ('negatively impacted, and may continue to negatively impact'). Direct exposure to tariffs, commodities, and transportation. Stable trend but high weight given dependence on resin, sodium hypochlorite, and chemical derivatives.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.summary: Clorox relies on numerous suppliers, some of which are sole or single-source. Interruptions in the delivery of raw materials could lead to product shortages and disrupt sales.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in Risk Factors with impact language ('can result in product shortages or disruptions'). Sole or single-source suppliers explicitly mentioned. Stable trend but increased risk due to macroeconomic context and ongoing ERP transition.

risks.title: Risks related to ERP system transition
risks.summary: Clorox is investing $570-580 million to replace its IT system and migrate to the cloud. This major transition, launching in the U.S. in 2026, carries risks of operational disruptions and budget overruns.
risks.score_rationale: Transformational investment of $570-580 million over 5 years underway since 2022. U.S. implementation launched in FY2026 following success in Canada. Risk of operational interruption and cost overruns. Trend is new/increasing with imminent rollout.

risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainties and consumer behavior
risks.summary: Growing economic uncertainties are altering consumer purchasing behaviors, causing temporary slowdowns in certain product categories and reducing sales.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in the Business Performance section ('heightened macroeconomic uncertainties drove changes in shopping behaviors'). Observable impact in FY2025 with temporary category slowdowns. Trend is new/increasing reflecting current context.

risks.title: Dependence on brands and brand equity
risks.summary: More than 80% of Clorox's sales come from leading brands. Loss of brand equity or competitive position could severely affect profitability and growth.
risks.score_rationale: Implicit but critical risk: 80% of sales come from #1 or #2 brands. Patents and Trademarks section emphasizes that 'Maintenance of brand equity value is critical to the Company s success'. Stable trend but concentrated vulnerability.

risks.title: Risks related to divestitures and restructurings
risks.summary: Clorox sold its Better Health VMS business in 2024 and will sell Glad to P&G in 2026. These restructurings carry valuation and integration risks, with losses already recorded.
risks.score_rationale: Two major divestitures in FY2025: Better Health VMS (September 2024) and Glad (January 2026). Losses recorded and valuation risks. Trend is new/increasing with ongoing financial and operational impacts.

ai_positioning.summary: The company CLX does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K report for the 2025 fiscal year. There is no reference to AI as a strategic, technological, or operational tool.
